title: galium capense var. scabrum
intro: Galium capense var. scabrum, commonly known as Rough Rockrose, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and phenolic compounds. The health benefits of Galium capense var. scabrum include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as galiumine and gallic acid, are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
